subject: Primary successor V5 package: Gen7 V3 + donor/UI/debug/process continuity
body: Successor package updated from the Gen6 Canonical Canvas Primary V4 archive. V5 preserves historical Primary/manager/process-learning assets but changes the active deployment prompt to Gen7. It includes current observed main db0810e55a411a905f3877cc2a3518881c044daf, exact Gen7 Alpha1 V3 review artifact and report, V3 MODEL/local/package status with CI and physical Fold7 still NOT_RUN, Animation Lab and duo-fold-live donor adaptation, diagnostic-first UI and causal bug reporting, PRIVATE_FROST > VIDEO_PASSTHROUGH > PUBLIC_GLASS, secure-capture boundary, 30s/60s service and message persistence rules, regression continuity, multi-cycle design/test contract, expanded capability research subjects, message-board communication optimization mandate, live discovery/integrity drift warning, and immediate successor execution order. New agents must still fetch live GitHub/AgentBus before work.
